title: Rhythm begins
html_source:
The syntax, density and obscurity of the interior monologue make it impossible for the first time reader to remember Stephen is on errands (possibly). They are the delivery of his Hamlet theory to Haines and Mulligan at the Ship and Deasy’s letter to The Evening Telegraph and The Irish Homestead not to mention the fact we are aware he is homeless for tonight at least.

“But it is important to remember the unsettling effect that his homlessness, however temporary , will have on Stephen’s sense of his situation throughout the day” (Norris,M. Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses).

Unbeknownst to us, for the moment at least, Stephen is composing a poem on his walk on the strand.
